description: Get the similar-products settings of a product card: its binding_mode plus the bound objects for that mode — product_card_ids for SELECTED_CARDS, category_ids and collection_ids for SELECTED_CATEGORIES_COLLECTIONS, none for ALL_VARIANTS (up to 500 IDs each). A 404 means the card has no settings yet — create them with set_similar_cards_mode action="create". These settings are separate from the deprecated symmetric links of GetSimilarProductCardIDs — neither API sees the other's bindings. The response carries a machine-readable coverage envelope (coverage, received, total_count, pages_read); coverage:"partial" MUST be reflected in the user-facing answer and forbids claiming the listing is complete.

product_card_id.description: Product card ID (UUID) — the variant's product_card_id, not a product or variant ID.

name: get_similar_cards
title: Get similar-products settings
